_: Film « Il était une fois… un logo », version EN (18/10/2026, traduction validée par Kévin). « tts » = texte lu par la voix (MACROARSENAL en deux mots).

lines.text: Once upon a time… a logo.
A little golden shield, watching over the markets of the world.
Every night, it saw traders, alone in front of their screens.
Thousands of numbers. Decisions to make… and no one to talk to.
Deep down, it dreamed of coming to life… to be by their side.
So MACROARSENAL made you a companion.
lines.tts: So Macro Arsenal made you a companion.

lines.text: And one fine morning… its eyes lit up!
Ever since, it watches over you, day and night. It knows your account by heart.
A major release coming up? It warns you in time.
A screen doesn't make sense? One click, and it explains it.
It prepares your orders… but you decide. Always.
It doesn't promise miracles. It helps you keep a cool head.
On days of doubt, it's there. On days of victory too.
And sometimes… it even makes you smile.
Need some quiet? One click, and it steps aside. It comes back the moment you call.
It doesn't have a name yet. You'll be the one to give it.
Three questions a day to get to know each other. Fifteen with Founder. And with Arsenal… it's all yours.

lines.tts: Macro Arsenal. Never trade alone again.

acting: Read it like the opening of a fairy tale in an animated feature film, in English: begin softly, almost whispered, full of mystery on 'Once upon a time… a logo', with long natural pauses at every ellipsis. Gentle melancholy for the lonely traders at night. Then rising tenderness, warmth and hope on 'So Macro Arsenal made you a companion', and pure wonder and joy on 'its eyes lit up'. Slow storytelling pace, every word clear.
